fiducial_mass.quote: few counts per day per 100 tonnes of target

target_mass.note: 278 t is the target (active) liquid-scintillator mass stated in the Extended Data Fig. 1 caption of the 2014 Nature pp-neutrino paper.
target_mass.quote: The buffer and target scintillator masses are 889 and 278 t, respectively.

summary.plain: A nylon sphere full of ultra-pure liquid, watched by photomultiplier tubes, that catches the faint flashes of light neutrinos leave behind as they pass through.
summary.technical: Liquid-scintillator (pseudocumene+PPO) detector, 278 t active mass, ~100 t fiducial mass, in a nylon vessel with a water-Cherenkov muon veto; operated at LNGS Hall C from May 2007 to October 2021.

technology.locator: arXiv:2006.15115 Methods, "Experimental setup and neutrino detection technique"
technology.note: Quoted from the Borexino collaboration's 2020 CNO paper (Methods). The 2014 Nature paper's Extended Data Fig. 1 caption adds the 13.7 m stainless-steel sphere, the 8.5 m nylon inner vessel and the 2,100 t water tank; the CNO paper gives the 2212 PMTs and the buffer liquid.
technology.quote: The SSS contains the organic liquid and supports the photomultipliers (PMTs) ... is the active medium of a Cherenkov muon tagger. ... The inner nylon vessel (IV), concentric to the SSS, contains a solution of Pseudocumene (PC) as solvent and PPO (2,5-diphenyloxazole) as fluor
technology.value: A nylon-sphere vessel of pseudocumene+PPO liquid scintillator viewed by photomultiplier tubes, surrounded by buffer liquid and a water-Cherenkov muon veto
